title: Localization of the prime-to-ell alteration site at an alteration object
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning that it admits a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $\ell$ be a prime. Let $T\to S$ be an object of $\operatorname{alt}/S$, with the category and topology of $\ell^{\prime}$-alterations defined in [def-per-prime-to-ell-alteration-topology]. Thus $T$ is reduced and finite type over $S$, and its generic points map to generic points of $S$ with finite residue-field extensions. The slice category $(\operatorname{alt}/S)/T$ has as objects morphisms $X\to T$ in $\operatorname{alt}/S$, and as morphisms the commuting triangles over $T$. Composition with $T\to S$ induces an equivalence $\operatorname{alt}/T\simeq(\operatorname{alt}/S)/T$, acting as the identity on the underlying schemes and their maps over $T$. Under this equivalence the topology of $\ell^{\prime}$-alterations on $\operatorname{alt}/T$ equals the localized topology of $\operatorname{alt}/S$ [def-weil-pbc-topos]: a sieve on an object $X\to T$ is covering in the localized topology exactly when its underlying sieve on $X$ is covering in $\operatorname{alt}/S$. In particular, for every set-indexed family of objects $X_a\to T$ of $\operatorname{alt}/T$, the family is covering in $\operatorname{alt}/T$ if and only if its corresponding family of arrows to $T$ is covering in $\operatorname{alt}/S$.
